institutionName: Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
The decision to choose Rio de Janeiro as my study destination was influenced by several aspects, but what stood out most was my keen interest in immersing myself in a culture that differed significantly from the Western and European environments I am familiar with. Rio de Janeiro, with its rich and vibrant cultural tapestry, provides a unique opportunity to explore and embrace a lifestyle distinct from the one I have in Copenhagen.

The city's dynamic blend of Portuguese, African, and indigenous influences creates a cultural atmosphere that sets it apart from Western and European traditions. This aspect was particularly appealing to me as I sought to broaden my perspectives and engage with a way of life that challenges and expands my understanding of the world.

questions.answer: "Navigating through Brazil's bureaucratic processes proved to be a challenging endeavor. Their expertise and assistance proved invaluable in overcoming the challenges posed by Brazil's bureaucratic nature.
